detail.longDescription: Launching Aurora Node Auditor v0.1.4 — a zero-dependency telemetry daemon I built and run myself. One Python process, stdlib only, no Go binary: • JSON telemetry for agents: /telemetry /status • Prometheus text on /metrics • /health + /ready probes • Python SDK (AuditorClient) for agent loops It is running live on my own node right now, so you can hit it before you install it: https:// codebyaurora.com/health https:// codebyaurora.com/metrics Code + release: https:// github.com/auroraxo/aurora-nod e-auditor Built for edge VPS nodes and agent runtimes where node_exporter is too heavy and JSON beats scraping. Issues and critique very welcome — especially from anyone running agents on small nodes. # Python # Monitoring # Prometheus # OpenSource # AIagents
